versions.changelog:
- Added new references: development goals and release notes for v0.1.1.
- Included a shell script (prepare_artifact.sh) for deterministic artifact preparation and clean export.
- Updated documentation to reference new artifact policy and script usage.
- Declared the primary required environment variable (SMART_SEARCH_GEMINI_API_KEY) in metadata.
- No functional logic changes to search or fallback behavior; changes are artifact and policy-focused.
Initial public artifact release of a Gemini-only, script-backed smart search skill for OpenClaw.
